intro.text_02: Project-based technical accounting for IFRS, Dutch GAAP and selected US GAAP matters, including Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS conversions, accounting memos and complex transactions.

deliverables.heading_01: From the question to a defensible answer.
deliverables.text_02: Typical deliverables are agreed as part of the engagement.
deliverables.text_03: Gap assessments, transition adjustments, opening balance sheets, comparatives and disclosure support.
deliverables.text_04: Written position papers on revenue, leases, provisions, financial instruments and judgemental transactions.
deliverables.text_05: Group accounting adjustments, reporting packages, consolidation schedules and financial statements.
deliverables.text_06: Accounting assessments for acquisitions, disposals, restructuring and business combinations.

technical_accounting.text_02: A specialist service for complex reporting requirements—not routine bookkeeping or ongoing FP&A. Work starts with a scope assessment and an agreed project fee.
